only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~32% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.131), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9693. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.131); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.611.
